name: SubArabify Arabic Subtitles
overview: On-server EN→AR subtitles with untouched timings. Native Python companion — runs on normal servers and on Android via Termux.
description: SubArabify server companion (NOT a .NET plugin — do not Install from the catalog). Add this repository for version/discovery info with the SubArabify icon, then enable with one command: Termux `bash jellyfin-addon/run-termux.sh ~/storage/movies`, or server `pip install -r jellyfin-addon/requirements.txt` + `python jellyfin-addon/subarabify_jellyfin.py --media /media --watch`. On enable it downloads the small Arabic model once, then writes Movie.SubArabify.ar.srt next to each video with bit-identical timings. Full docs: jellyfin-addon/README.md.

versions.changelog: 1.0.4-pre: optional Colab T4 full-movie Arabic transcription backend (samil24/whisper-large-arabic-dialects-v5) + client; async jobs + timing-safe branding.
